verdict.rationale: Amazon SES's Virtual Deliverability Manager provides in-product deliverability insights and recommendations drawn from the user's sending data, and can implement those recommendations automatically. That covers the 'insights and suggestions from my data' part of the story. The evidence never says these insights are AI-generated, and they are limited to deliverability. Missing for 10: any evidence that the insights or recommendations are AI- or ML-generated, insights beyond deliverability (e.g., content or engagement analysis), detailed documentation of how the recommendations are produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: With Virtual Deliverability Manager, email senders are able to track their email deliverability through deliverability insights and improve email inbox placement
Email senders can also enable Virtual Deliverability Manager to automatically implement recommendations that instantly improve their email deliverability.
